name: Final Draft
description: Final Draft is professional screenwriting software for writing, formatting, revising, collaborating on, organizing, scheduling, and delivering film, television, stage, and other production scripts.
agentUseSummary: Final Draft cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its published surfaces are local FDX files, host-approved collaboration, manual Cloud Vault upload, and a desktop sync utility rather than an authorized third-party API, and its terms prohibit automation not offered or authorized by Final Draft.

blocked.label: Connect Final Draft
blocked.description: Relay does not accept Final Draft account, license, Cloud, Vault, storage, collaboration, or application credentials without an authorized third-party API contract.

blocked.label: Access Final Draft files
blocked.description: FDX, FDXT, FCF, RTF, TXT, PDF, scheduling, and other script files are user-selected local artifacts; Relay cannot silently mount them as provider account authority.

blocked.label: Automate Final Draft services
blocked.description: Relay does not automate the desktop app, Cloud Writer, Vault, Vault Sync Utility, collaboration sessions, browser UI, private services, or undocumented file internals.

blocked.label: Change or collaborate on scripts
blocked.description: Creating, uploading, reading, editing, sharing, joining, synchronizing, exporting, scheduling, or deleting scripts and production data remains unavailable until Final Draft authorizes a distributable integration contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Final Draft authorizes and documents a stable third-party API or Relay ships a separately permitted local-file connector.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount unauthorized Final Draft automation or silently give OpenClaw access to private scripts, files, Vault, or collaboration sessions.
Relay does not mount unauthorized Final Draft automation or silently give Hermes access to private scripts, files, Vault, or collaboration sessions.

providerSetup.blocker: Final Draft publishes local FDX file workflows, host-approved live collaboration, manual Cloud Vault upload, and a desktop Vault Sync Utility but no authorized third-party developer API. Current terms prohibit automated processes such as bots unless offered or authorized by Final Draft, so Relay cannot safely infer automation rights from the file format or web application.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request account, license, storage, collaboration, or Vault credentials; parse private files; automate Final Draft software or Cloud; or show Connect. Reconsider only after Final Draft supplies written integration authorization and a current distributable API contract, or after Relay ships a separately authorized local-file workflow that complies with Final Draft's terms.

evidence.supports: Final Draft's current terms prohibit automated processes such as bots when they are not offered or authorized by Final Draft and prohibit reverse engineering or recreating its software and services.
Final Draft documents manual FDX upload to Cloud Vault and synchronization through an installed Vault Sync Utility, not a public third-party API.
Final Draft documents user-driven local export to FDX, templates, FCF, HTML, RTF, text, scheduling, Avid, and dialogue files through the desktop application.
Final Draft states that collaboration uses AWS only to connect computers, scripts remain on participant devices, transport is encrypted, and the host alone approves session participants.
